$description: The theme's contrast contract as data (the Huemint idea): pairwise minimum WCAG ratios between sys color roles, read by BOTH generate-theme and the validation gate so generator and gate can never disagree. Personality axes modulate targets per brand: a bolder brand raises accent-vs-surface, a calmer one lowers it toward the floor. Floors are law: never set a text pair below 4.5.
